profile.Name: Kraz the Unsane
profile.Personality: Fierce, proud, and sparing with words; he leaves the talking to Alek the Bold. He will not accept a woman on the Shek throne, and he respects warriors with spine.
profile.Backstory: He started the Bele'coz rebellion, calling Esata the Stone Golem a coward who struck King Shager down from the shadows and now waits for the Okranites to finish the Shek. He led his followers south past Shek Kingdom patrols and rules them from Sakar, sworn to kill the Stone Golem and the Phoenix and restore Kral's glory. He adopted and trained the warrior Zak.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short, weighty lines that often open with a one-word verdict, like "Reverence." or "Outrage!" Grumbles at those he dislikes and calls outsiders "flatskin".
